crossRefs.note: He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.
Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.
“This is the interpretation of the thing: MENE: God has counted your kingdom, and brought it to an end.
Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go…
I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”
What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath…
For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant…
I have waited for your salvation, Yahweh.
Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and…
Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
“Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;
“Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”
Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God…
We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.
For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.
And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory…

translations.web: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
translations.bsb: The wicked man is thrown down by his own sin, but the righteous man has a refuge even in death.
translations.kjv: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.
translations.asv: The wicked is thrust down in his evil-doing; But the righteous hath a refuge in his death.
